title: Type 2 diabetes predicted effector genes - Effector index method (Forgetta V et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

An effector index to predict target genes at GWAS loci.
Forgetta V, Jiang L, Vulpescu NA, et al.
Hum Genet. 2022 Feb 11. doi: 10.1007/s00439-022-02434-z.
PMID: 35147782

The Effector Index (Ei) algorithm calculates the probability of causality for each gene at a locus that harbors genome-wide significant SNVs for a disease or trait. Click the Research Method tab for more details on the method.

More detailed evidence for these type 2 diabetes effector gene predictions is available here.

The T2D effector prediction summary page compares these results with type 2 diabetes effector gene predictions generated by two other methods.
